question: How can I apply for Undergraduate Admissions at UET Taxila?
answer: Visit the official admission portal **admissions.uettaxila.edu.pk** and click on “MY UET”. Register using your CNIC/Form-B number, fill the online application form, and deposit the Rs. 4000 application processing fee through HBL Konnect or Internet Banking.

question: What is the Application Processing Fee and how do I pay it?
answer: The application processing fee is **Rs. 4,000**. It can be paid by using following methods after generating Admission Processing Fee voucher from admission portal, Payment Methods: i. HBL Mobile App: Go to payments, Select 1-Bill Invoice, Enter Consumer Number (Prefix+Voucher No) and Process payment. ,take screen shoot of successfull transaction. ii. Bank Of Punjab Branch:- Print Admission Processing Fee Voucher, Visit the BOP branch submit the fee, upload the paid fee challan/ Paid Fee Proof to admission Portal.

question: What are the eligibility criteria for admission?
answer: You must have passed F.Sc (Pre-Engineering) / ICS / DAE (relevant field) or equivalent with at least **60% marks** for Engineering programs and **50% marks** for BS Math/ Physics /Computer Science / Engineering Technology programs. You must also appear in the TCAT/ECAT/Equivalent test.

question: What is the minimum percentage required in FSc for admission?
answer: You must have passed F.Sc (Pre-Engineering) / ICS / DAE (relevant field) or equivalent with at least **60% marks** for Engineering programs and **50% marks** for BS Math/ Physics /Computer Science / Engineering Technology programs. You must also appear in the TCAT/ECAT/Equivalent test.

question: What percentage of marks is required in FSc, ICS or DAE to be eligible?
answer: You must have passed F.Sc (Pre-Engineering) / ICS / DAE (relevant field) or equivalent with at least **60% marks** for Engineering programs and **50% marks** for BS Math/ Physics /Computer Science / Engineering Technology programs. You must also appear in the TCAT/ECAT/Equivalent test.

question: What is TCAT/ECAT/Equivalent and when is the test held?
answer: TCAT/ECAT/Equivalent (Engineering University Admission Test) is conducted by UET Lahore. Registration usually starts in February/March. Register at [admission.uet.edu.pk](<https://admission.uet.edu.pk/>).

question: How is the merit calculated?
answer: Merit Formula: • HSSC-I / DAE (1st and 2nd Year)/ Equivalent = 50% • TCAT/ECAT/Equivalent / Entry Test = 33% • SSC / Matric = 17%

question: Can HSSC Pre-Medical students apply for Engineering programs?
answer: Yes, HSSC Pre-Medical students can apply for Engineering programs. However, they must qualify the ECAT/ TCAT / or an equivalent test with Mathematics as an additional subject/combination. Applicants are also required to provide the result of the Additional Mathematics paper or the Condensed Mathematics course, as per the admission requirements of the respective university.

question: What is the fee structure for the first semester?
answer: • Regular (Subsidized) ≈ Rs. 104,800 (without hostel) • Partial-Subsidized (S & X categories) ≈ Rs. 339,800+ Exact fee is mentioned in the prospectus and on the fee structure page.

question: Is hostel facility available?
answer: Limited hostel seats are available for male students on merit basis. Female students have very limited accommodation. Hostel dues are approximately Rs. 36,000 – 40,000 1st semester.

question: What documents are required at the time of admission?
answer: Original + attested photocopies of 1. SSC 2. HSSC/DAE / Equivalent 3. TCAT/ECAT/Equivalent result card 4. CNIC/Form-B 5. Father’s CNIC 6. Domicile 7. recent passport size photographs For More Information kindly read the propectus available online to check the needed documents.

question: Can DAE students apply for admission?
answer: Yes, DAE holders in relevant technologies from PBTE are eligible to apply in Engineering and Engineering Technology programs. They must appear in TCAT/ECAT/Equivalent.

question: When are the merit lists announced?
answer: Multiple merit lists are displayed after the TCAT/ECAT/Equivalent result. You must regularly check your “MY UET” account on the admission portal.

question: What undergraduate programs are offered?
answer: **Engineering:** Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Computer, Software, Telecommunication, Electronics, Industrial, Environmental, Mechatronics **Computer Science:** BS Computer Science **Engineering Technology (Afternoon):** Cyber Security, Software **Basic Sciences:** BS Physics, BS Mathematics

question: How can I contact the Admission Office?
answer: **Email:** ug.admission@uettaxila.edu.pk **Phone:** +92-51-9047400–412 Office Timing: Monday to Friday (9:00 AM – 3:00 PM)

question: What steps need to follow after merit list?
answer: Students who have been offered admission need to complete the following steps: 1. Pay the semester fee to secure your seat. 2. After paying the semester fee, upload the paid challan form on admission portal, scrutiny team will verify the uploaded documents. 3. Candidate needs to check his/her email and admission portal regularly for re-upload documents/ upcoming merit lists. 4. Wait for the original document submission plan, it will be available in the end of July or start of August.

question: How to apply for Semester Grade Sheets?
answer: Semester Grade Sheets (SGS) can be received from **Student Facilitation Center opposite to HBL Bank UET Taxila**, during the office hours quite after the notification of Results of semester 1 to semester 7 without any fee only by submitting “Degree-Transcript- SGS-Provisional etc. Form (Form H)” available on UET website in Examinations Download Section. However if the Result of next semester is notified then the Previous SGS will be issued after paying prescribed fee @ per semester.

question: How to apply for a particular Bonafied Certificate?
answer: A Bonafied Certificate can be received from Examination Branch UET Taxila by submitting “Degree-Transcript- SGS-Provisional etc. Form (Form H)” available on UET website in Examinations Download Section and depositing prescribed fee in the bank. A completely filled Form along with required documents be submitted at **Student Facilitation Center opposite to HBL Bank UET Taxila** during the office hours and required certificate will be received from the same place after due course of time.

question: How to apply for an Incomplete Transcript?
answer: An Incomplete Transcript can be received from Examination Branch UET Taxila by submitting “Degree-Transcript- SGS-Provisional etc. Form (Form H)” available on UET website in Examinations Download Section and depositing prescribed fee in the bank. A completely filled Form along with required documents be submitted at **Student Facilitation Center opposite to HBL Bank UET Taxila** during the office hours and required document will be received from the same place after due course of time for all the notified results.

question: How to apply for a Transcript?
answer: A Transcript can be received from Examination Branch UET Taxila by submitting “Degree-Transcript- SGS-Provisional etc. Form (Form H)” available on UET website in Examinations Download Section and depositing prescribed fee in the bank. A completely filled Form along with required documents be submitted at **Student Facilitation Center opposite to HBL Bank UET Taxila** during the office hours and required document will be received from the **OFFICE OF THE CONTROLLER OF EXAMINATIONS** after due course of time provided that **Comprehensive Result** has been notified, copy of **Clarence Certificate** has been attached along with all other necessary documents.

question: How to apply for a Provisional Certificate?
answer: A Provisional Certificate can be received from Examination Branch UET Taxila by submitting “Degree-Transcript- SGS-Provisional etc. Form (Form H)” available on UET website in Examinations Download Section and depositing prescribed fee in the bank. A completely filled Form along with required documents be submitted at **Student Facilitation Center opposite to HBL Bank UET Taxila** during the office hours and required document will be received from the **OFFICE OF THE CONTROLLER OF EXAMINATIONS** after due course of time provided that **Transcript** has already been received, **Original Clarence Certificate** has been attached along with all other necessary documents.

question: How to apply for the Degree?
answer: A Degree can be received from Examination Branch UET Taxila by submitting “Degree-Transcript- SGS-Provisional etc. Form (Form H)” available on UET website in Examinations Download Section and depositing prescribed fee in the bank. A completely filled Form along with required documents be submitted at **Student Facilitation Center opposite to HBL Bank UET Taxila** during the office hours and required document will be received from the **OFFICE OF THE CONTROLLER OF EXAMINATIONS** in Person after due course of time provided that **Transcript and Provisional** has already been received **and their copies** has been attached along with all other necessary documents.

question: How to apply for the verification of a Degree from within Pakistan?
answer: A Degree or any other issued document can be verified for with in Pakistan, from Examination Branch UET Taxila by submitting “**Local Verification Form**” available on UET website in Examinations Download Section and depositing prescribed fee in the bank. A completely filled Form along with required documents be submitted at **Student Facilitation Center opposite to HBL Bank UET Taxila** during the office hours and required document will be received from the **OFFICE OF THE CONTROLLER OF EXAMINATIONS** in Person after due course of time **OR** through Courier with paid return envelope having return Address **OR** through E-mail by depositing Fee online and attaching paid receipt.

question: How to apply for the verification of a Degree from outside Pakistan?
answer: A Degree or any other issued document can be verified for **outside Pakistan**, from Examination Branch UET Taxila by submitting “**International Verification Form**” available on UET website in Examinations Download Section and depositing prescribed fee in the bank. A completely filled Form along with required documents be sent to the **OFFICE OF THE CONTROLLER OF EXAMINATIONS** through Courier with paid return envelope having return Address **OR** through E-mail by depositing Fee online and attaching paid receipt.

question: How to apply for an Additional Course in a Regular Semester?
answer: Student can apply for an Additional Course in a regular semester by submitting “Additional Course Form” available on UET website in Examinations Download Section. All instruction given on form and prevailing Policy of the University will apply.

question: How to apply for Summer Semester?
answer: Summer Semester is an optional Semester. University may offer Summer Semester only if Department has sufficient resources and can offer optional Summer Semester. Student can apply for summer semester (If Offered) by submitting “Summer Semester Form” available on UET website in Examinations Download Section. All instruction given on form and prevailing Policy of the University will apply.

question: How to apply for Re-Mid?
answer: If student has got proper approval for Re-Mid due some Valid Reasons then Student can apply for Retake of Mid Term Examination by submitting “Re-Mid Form” available on UET website in Examinations Download Section. All instruction given on form and prevailing Policy of the University will apply.

question: How to get freezing of a Semester?
answer: If student has some valid reasons and want to get freeze one or Two Consecutive Semesters then Student can apply for Freezing of Semester (s) by submitting “Freezing-Semester-Form” available on UET website in Examinations Download Section. All instruction given on form and prevailing Policy of the University will apply.

question: How to apply for I-Grade?
answer: If student has some valid unforeseen reasons and cannot appear in Final Term Examinations. Student has to get proper approval for I-Grade then Student can apply for approval of I-Grade by submitting “I-Grade Form” available on UET website in Examinations Download Section. All instruction given on form and prevailing Policy of the University will apply. After the approval of I-Grade all such papers are needed to passed before the next End Term Examinations otherwise all subjects will be marked as “F” Grade.

question: How to get Relegation to Lower Entry?
answer: If student has some valid reasons for Willing Relegation or need to get Relegation to Lower Entry due Academic Deficiency then Student can apply for Relegation by submitting “Relegation Form” available on UET website in Examinations Download Section. All instruction given on form and prevailing Policy of the University will apply.

question: How to apply for Rechecking of Paper(s)?
answer: If student has passed/failed a paper and want to confirm about the calculation of Marks then Student can apply for Rechecking of Paper(s) by submitting “Rechecking Form” available on UET website in Examinations Download Section. Rechecking only means recalculation but not re-evaluation. All instruction given on form and prevailing Policy of the University will apply.

question: How to apply for Casual Student Registration?
answer: If student has passed all the degree requirements but need to improve CGPA or has failed in some regular papers and has taken these courses as an additional course or want to take then Student has to apply for such reasons by submitting “Casual Student Registration Form” before the **Comprehensive Notification of Result**. Form is available on UET website in Examinations Download Section. All instruction given on form and prevailing Policy of the University will apply.
